verses.text: Bless Jehovah, O my soul; And all that is within me, bless his holy name.

segments.text: Bless Jehovah, O my soul;
And all that is within me,
bless
his holy name.

verses.text: Bless Jehovah, O my soul, And forget not all his benefits:

segments.text: Bless Jehovah, O my soul,
And forget not all his benefits:

verses.text: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; Who healeth all thy diseases;

segments.text: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities;
Who healeth all thy diseases;

verses.text: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; Who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

segments.text: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction;
Who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

verses.text: Who satisfieth thy desire with good things, So that thy youth is renewed like the eagle.

segments.text: Who satisfieth thy desire with good things,
So that
thy youth is renewed like the eagle.

verses.text: Jehovah executeth righteous acts, And judgments for all that are oppressed.

segments.text: Jehovah executeth righteous acts,
And judgments for all that are oppressed.

verses.text: He made known his ways unto Moses, His doings unto the children of Israel.

segments.text: He made known his ways unto Moses,
His doings unto the children of Israel.

verses.text: Jehovah is merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness.

segments.text: Jehovah is merciful and gracious,
Slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness.

verses.text: He will not always chide; Neither will he keep his anger for ever.

segments.text: He will not always chide;
Neither will he keep
his anger
for ever.

verses.text: He hath not dealt with us after our sins, Nor rewarded us after our iniquities.

segments.text: He hath not dealt with us after our sins,
Nor rewarded us after our iniquities.

verses.text: For as the heavens are high above the earth, So great is his lovingkindness toward them that fear him.

segments.text: For as the heavens are high above the earth,
So great is his lovingkindness toward them that fear him.

verses.text: As far as the east is from the west, So far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

segments.text: As far as the east is from the west,
So far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

verses.text: Like as a father pitieth his children, So Jehovah pitieth them that fear him.

segments.text: Like as a father pitieth his children,
So Jehovah pitieth them that fear him.

verses.text: For he knoweth our frame; He remembereth that we are dust.

segments.text: For he knoweth our frame;
He remembereth that we are dust.

verses.text: As for man, his days are as grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

segments.text: As for man, his days are as grass;
As a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

verses.text: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; And the place thereof shall know it no more.

segments.text: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone;
And the place thereof shall know it no more.

verses.text: But the lovingkindness of Jehovah is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, And his righteousness unto children’s children;

segments.text: But the lovingkindness of Jehovah is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him,
And his righteousness unto children’s children;

verses.text: To such as keep his covenant, And to those that remember his precepts to do them.

segments.text: To such as keep his covenant,
And to those that remember his precepts to do them.

verses.text: Jehovah hath established his throne in the heavens; And his kingdom ruleth over all.

segments.text: Jehovah hath established his throne in the heavens;
And his kingdom ruleth over all.

verses.text: Bless Jehovah, ye his angels, That are mighty in strength, that fulfil his word, Hearkening unto the voice of his word.

segments.text: Bless Jehovah, ye his angels,
That are mighty in strength, that fulfil his word,
Hearkening unto the voice of his word.

verses.text: Bless Jehovah, all ye his hosts, Ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.

segments.text: Bless Jehovah, all ye his hosts,
Ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.

verses.text: Bless Jehovah, all ye his works, In all places of his dominion: Bless Jehovah, O my soul.

segments.text: Bless Jehovah, all ye his works,
In all places of his dominion:
Bless Jehovah, O my soul.
